issue.title: v3: context value added in Before missing in After when subcommands are involved

comments.author: bystones
comments.body:
My first attempt was this: https://github.com/bystones/cli/commit/acb130d5ded823301ba5b2b2a3a0c557735e45ef
Moving the defer of the After function down and doing the same "chain" thing as the Before function fixes the test and keeps "make test" green as well.

The problem with that fix attempt is that it changes behavior around other error handling which seems to be currently untested. For example the following test passes before that change and breaks after: https://github.com/bystones/cli/commi
